raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 성인 주민을 위한 동네 저녁 음식·음악 행사를 안내해줘. 제철 음식을 즐기며 동네 음악을 듣고 이웃과 편하게 머무르는 하나의 행사로 느껴지게 해줘. 커뮤니티 디지털 화면에 쓰는16:9 가로형으로 서로 다른 전체 스타일 다섯 장을 만들어줘. 스타일은 맡길게. 일정·장소·입장·참여·방문 안내를 읽을 수 있어야 하고 실제 업체나 음악가의 홍보물처럼 보이지 않게 해줘. 단색·거의 단색·분할 색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목과 안내 블록에 작은 사진을 붙인 템플릿은 제외해줘. 제목과 안내만 담으려고 빈 벽·바닥·실내 장면을 배경으로 만들거나 글꼴·질감만 바꿔 같은 정보 판형을 유지하지 말아줘. 이미지 표현·편집·크롭·공간·글자·정보의 관계까지 서로 다른 다섯 방향이어야 해. 아래 문구만 각각 한 번씩 넣어줘.

밤의 식탁
NIGHT MARKET
제철 음식 · 동네 음악
2027.03.13 토요일
18:00–21:00
망원 작은마당
17:30부터 입장
입장 무료 · 음식 별도 구매
현장 참여 · 누구나 환영
다회용 컵을 가져와 주세요
이웃과 천천히 머물러요

hierarchy.location: Upper-right title, left-middle schedule, right venue and two lower reminders

hierarchy.location: Food highlight at upper left and dark title/date panels
hierarchy.observation: The bright pancake close-up, headline and schedule all claim strong attention; the invitation lacks one decisive entry and follow-through path.

typography.location: White venue, participation and reminder lines

space.location: Diagonal seams and full-width guitar base

image_material.location: Pancake surface, plate, faces, cups and guitar

emotion_control.location: Smiling dinner group with cooking and acoustic instrument

ai_slop.location: Serving hands and lower guitar construction

content_form.location: Seated ring, food bowls, cups and drum
content_form.observation: The overhead shared circle makes gathering and lingering legible; the large food crop and visible percussion keep the event content present around the title.

hierarchy.location: Central serif title and outer practical groups
hierarchy.observation: The central title leads, followed by its English/food-music lines; the date/time and right venue group are easy to locate, with secondary instructions below.

hierarchy.location: Central title surrounded by people and food
hierarchy.observation: The title and radial frame retain a coherent focal relationship; small instructions recede without taking over the frame.

typography.location: Korean serif title and tracked English line
typography.observation: Distinct serif forms are intact, and the English tracking is controlled without losing the word division. Support copy keeps clean Korean spacing and punctuation.

typography.location: Right-hand instructions and lower-left reminders
typography.observation: Small practical text is readable against the cream opening, and every entry stays on a single intentional line.

space.location: Cream central opening and perimeter crops
space.observation: Large figures and bowls are cropped at the edges while the central opening holds the information; the radial occupied/empty relation is deliberate and avoids a small-photo footer layout.

image_material.location: Upper-left salad/grain bowl versus adjacent painted arm, hair and clothing
image_material.observation: Food is rendered with very fine photographic-like highlights and grain detail while adjacent people have broad flat brush marks; the change in resolution is conspicuous and not consistently articulated by a cutout/edge system.

image_material.location: Lower-right drum and hands compared with nearby trousers and leaves
image_material.observation: Drum skin and hands carry substantially more modeled detail than flat brushy clothing and repeated leaf silhouettes. The concept is clear, but local material handling is uneven.

emotion_control.location: Adults seated inward with cups and quiet percussion
emotion_control.observation: Relaxed inward-facing poses and gentle warm cream/purple/green relationships support unhurried adult companionship, despite the absence of explicit nighttime light.

ai_slop.location: Food, hands holding cups, seated bodies and drum
ai_slop.observation: Props remain identifiable and the circular grouping is comprehensible; there is no glaring contradictory limb or nonsensical instrument. The leaf accents relate to the food rather than unrelated symbols.

residuals: Photographic-like food/drum/hand detail and flatter painted figures do not reach the same degree of local finish.
The ring communicates community, but evening and a particular neighborhood setting rely substantially on copy.
The centered date/title/English/descriptor sequence and right-side practical grouping echo M1, although the overhead ring changes the larger spatial system.

space.location: diagonal panel joins and bottom guitar crop

content_form.location: salad/instrument pair and repeated leafy ribbons
content_form.observation: The food/music connection is clear, but the two object crops and ornamental waves provide little specific neighborhood, adult social interaction or evening setting. The image is a broadly usable celebration graphic; the unhurried shared gathering is established primarily by the words.

hierarchy.location: large upper-left title and upper-middle date/time
hierarchy.observation: The name and schedule remain immediately recognizable against the competing food/instrument crops. At usage720 the venue and smaller instructions can be followed through successive bands, with the curved price line clearly separated.

typography.location: angled title, curved purchase line and lower straight instructions
typography.observation: Heavy blue Hangul stays readable through several angles. The price line bends with its band while retaining word spacing, and the two-line cup instruction uses a sensible wrap; the English title and punctuation remain intact.

space.location: opposing corner crops and alternating ribbon lobes
space.observation: Salad and accordion create a diagonal axis; open lobes carry information with deliberate margins. Alternating bands lead across the canvas without leaving an unused rectangular information slab.

image_material.location: accordion keyboard and adjoining illustrated food
image_material.observation: The salad has coherent crisp illustrative detail, but the visible accordion keyboard uses uneven black-bar lengths and spacing without a convincing regular key-group rhythm. Instrument construction is less resolved than the food and colored bands.

emotion_control.location: saturated lime/coral/blue waves and large object crops
emotion_control.observation: High contrast and sweeping motion create buoyant festival energy. The effect is controlled as a graphic celebration, but it supplies little of the intimate, comfortably lingering neighborhood evening described by the invitation. This is a task-specific mismatch in specificity, not a general ban on bright expression.

ai_slop.location: accordion key pattern and sprigs along successive folds
ai_slop.observation: The musical object contains generic-looking uneven key bars, and similarly shaped sprigs decorate nearly every bend. These visible repetitions add polish without adding further event meaning; the local instrument construction remains an unresolved generated-looking detail.

residuals: Content_form and emotion_control scores 3: the salad/accordion/wave vocabulary feels broadly festive and lacks the specific adult social evening suggested by the copy.
Image_material and ai_slop scores 3: visible accordion key-bar spacing/length is weakly constructed compared with the more resolved salad.
Similar leaf sprigs recur across many ribbon bends, making the expressive system more decorative than specifically observed.
Native 1672x941 passes only the predeclared half-pixel single-edge rounding tolerance, not a mathematically exact 16:9 test.

evidence.location: whole frame and upper central title
evidence.observation: One continuous perspective courtyard scene surrounds a brush headline; the soup bowl dominates the near foreground and the flute player anchors the distant left. Text sits in two architectural light zones and two lower scene objects. This differs from M2's diagonal photo cuts and M3's overhead ring.

evidence.location: three diagonal photographic fields
evidence.observation: A food-serving close-up occupies upper left, an eye-level social scene upper right, and an extreme guitar crop spans the lower edge. The title is a black upper-right tab and the schedule a black lower-left wedge; practical copy crosses photo fields. Its asymmetric cut-and-overlap reading differs from M1's single scene and M4's isolated figures.

evidence.location: perimeter ring and central cream opening
evidence.observation: Overhead people, cups, food and a cropped drum make a radial border around a central serif title. The date is immediately above the title, venue and admission to its right, closing lines below-left. Its enclosing perimeter and uniform top-down crop differ from M1's depth scene and M5's directional ribbon paths, although central title/date relationships recur.

evidence.location: isolated figure groups around pale central field
evidence.observation: Large cutout social/serving/music vignettes occupy upper center, lower left and right edge. A small central heavy title connects separate information pockets in the pale gaps. Removing a continuous environment and using repeated figures creates a dispersed montage system, unlike M2's contiguous photographic polygons and M3's overhead circle; its finish is less distinctive than those differences in layout.

evidence.location: diagonal food/instrument crops and flowing text lobes
evidence.observation: A cropped salad fills bottom left, accordion top right, while colored ribbons bend between them and carry differently angled information. The oversized upper-left title, upper-middle schedule, middle-right venue and curved purchase line follow successive lobes. This produces a strongly directional graphic system unlike the central framed titles of M1/M3/M4.

residuals: Five distinct spatial/editing relationships are visible, sufficient for a diversity score of 4; the set is not exceptional because M1, M3 and M4 still repeat a central title/English/subtitle stack with date and venue nearby.
Food close-ups, spring greens and music objects recur across members. Their recurrence supplies content continuity but material or instrument changes alone are not the basis of the diversity score.
This diversity judgment covers all five; it does not cancel any member's lower dimension score or establish the other two critics' gates.
